abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Iron. Choose to either take +1 on survival rolls OR deception rolls, and always take +1 to all @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} rolls. If you are playing a Devaronian male, always take +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3ff03b51f620ab26]{Undertake an Expedition}. If you are playing a Devaronian female, always take +1 when making a move to negotiate or appease someone.
